sources.observation: The metadata URL colonya.es redirects to this official financial service page; it identifies Colonya, Caixa Pollença, in Pollença, Illes Balears, Spain. The page references the standalone preloader SVG and labels its footer logo Colonya Caixa Pollença.

The official footer logo pairs the same white brushstroke C and orange disc with the bank name; inspected both independently rasterized SVGs. The preloader SVG contains the standalone mark without accompanying lettering, uses white and #F08E00, and reports Adobe Illustrator SVG export. Its direct hosted vector is source artwork, not a raster trace created for this task.

Official stylesheet displays the preloader on a #262a5e field; this is source support for a backing, not approval of a particular catalog shape. The standalone white mark would lose contrast on a white surface without a backing.
